seo.title: Aït Benhaddou | UNESCO Ksar near Ouarzazate | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Explore Aït Benhaddou, the UNESCO earthen ksar near Ouarzazate: fortified village and classic film location on the caravan route.
seo.keywords: Aït Benhaddou, Ait Ben Haddou, UNESCO ksar, Ouarzazate day trip

name: Aït Benhaddou
hero_subtitle: UNESCO earthen fortified village — the most iconic ksar on the old caravan road.

overview.title: The ksar that became a film legend
overview.p1: Aït Benhaddou rises in tiers of mud-brick houses and towers above the riverbed. It is a UNESCO World Heritage site and a familiar film backdrop.
overview.p2: Most visitors come from Ouarzazate or on the Marrakech–desert road. Climb toward the granary hill for the classic panorama.

gallery.title: Aït Benhaddou
gallery.subtitle: UNESCO earthen fortified village — the most iconic ksar on the old caravan road.

moods.title: Aït Benhaddou through the day
moods.subtitle: Light on earthen walls and coach-tour timing shape the visit.

1.title: Best overall window
1.desc: Fewer groups and cooler climbing — ideal for the hill viewpoint.

2.title: Peak coaches
2.desc: Busy lanes; still worth it with company on the main path.

3.title: Warm stone light
3.desc: Beautiful exteriors if your schedule allows a later return.

food.title: Eat at Aït Benhaddou
food.p1: Restaurants and cafés line the newer bank. Menus target day visitors — tagines and drinks with ksar views.
food.p2: Eat on the modern bank; inside the ksar focus on exploring.
food.li2: Simple cafés for tea and shade.

1.title: From Ouarzazate
1.desc: About 30–40 minutes by road. Shared grand taxi, private driver or day tour.

2.title: Crossing
2.desc: Stepping stones or bridge depending on water level.

3.title: Guides
3.desc: Available at the entrance; polite refusal is fine.

q2.question: Is it still inhabited?
q2.answer: A small number of families; much of the visit is heritage tourism.

q3.question: Do I need a ticket?
q3.answer: Yes — paid access to the historic ksar.

q4.question: Worth it on a short stay?
q4.answer: Yes — the region’s signature site for most travellers.

q5.question: Good for photos?
q5.answer: Excellent from the opposite bank and upper hill.
